notes_for_editor: Thin: one registry listing (Tennessee Landforms) and one gazetteer entry. Two WebSearch calls, the Forest Lookouts and NHLR caches, the FFLOS Tennessee index, and the Putnam County photo archive found nothing on this tower's history. The story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence supports no more; the editor may prefer to hold it. The record elevation (605.9 m) matches the listing (1,988 ft).
